tools.name: synthesize_speech
tools.description: Generate a WAV from text with the operating-system voice. Returns MCP audio content plus metadata. The engine is macOS say; this is not Azure Speech.

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe WAV or other audio with whisper.cpp. Fails with the exact install step when whisper.cpp or its model is missing; it never invents a transcript.

audio.description: Base64 audio bytes, optionally a data:audio/...;base64 URL. Maximum 50 MB.

filename.description: Original file name; its extension selects the format. Defaults to "audio.wav".

tools.name: speech_status
tools.description: Report whether local text-to-speech and speech-to-text are available, with the install step when STT is missing.
